weightBudget.basis: Own 411114 triangle /20555784 byte single-cell stone frame. Four irregular masonry facades, deep real joints, one complete native pocket. Compare 100/140/180/220k after actual Meshopt16 before UV/bake; compare balanced1536/1280 with compact colour. Albedo muted grey brown from author PDF26, rough nonmetal stone, source AO/normal. Preserve inner receiving/chamfer within .02mm; body .15mm, all four texels <1mm.

reviewNotes: Own nine source views and .25mm facade grid inspected against author PDF page26. Irregular grey brown masonry, no wood/metal/plaster. Preserve sculpted stone seams via AO/normal and physical pigment variation. Native full D0/C0 receiving frame, no synthetic insert. One open through-hole; all25 actor candidates lack full49-point support/headroom. Own height25.0741996765mm X±17.4948005676 Y±17.5235996246. Source20 and final80 profile/rotation fits, >=1069 socket rays required. Dry geometry/UV/paint/candidate QA pending. Actual Meshopt16 dry 100/140/180/220k all5244 body/facing probes pass; 100k fails4 native socket probes and is rejected. Protected56660 inner/chamfer triangles. Retain render180k(maxbody.009824mm/socket.008550mm), LOD140k(maxbody.014638mm/socket.013335mm); all1069 socket rays pass both. UV preflight pending. UV .35rad/.0012 margin passed all5244 actual Meshopt16 physical four-texel probes: render1536 max.296328mm,LOD1280 max.278123mm. Source20 profile/rotation cases complete; painting and candidate comparison follow. First uniform stone candidate passed numerical QA but looked too monotone at close range; superseded. Source0.25mm facade depth watershed separated31+29 stone cores at17.35mm, flood valleys to15.95mm. 120 independent facade stone masks follow measured joints with restrained six-tone warm/cool/olive grey-brown variation; source AO/normal remains. New material QA required; geometry/UV settings unchanged.
